_help: What each skill in Data/player_skills.json DOES in the game. Every entry is 'skill name: bonus per skill point'.
Edit and restart to retune. A skill listed under a stat adds (its level x the number) to that stat; a stat with several
skills adds them all up. Two special names stand in for a skill that depends on the situation:
@weapon    the skill of the weapon in your hand (slashing_weapons, piercing_weapons, ... or hand_to_hand when unarmed)
@category  the skill the spell/ability itself belongs to (evocation, necromancy, backstab, mantis_fist, ...)
Skills grow at most 4 points per character level (skill_cap_per_level in combat_balance.json), so at level 10 a skill is 40:
0.15 per point then means +6. Only PLAYERS use this table; monsters, guards and pets are untouched.
Stats:
attack_rating          added to ATK (accuracy: ATK minus the target's AC). Weapon skill already counts x2 in ATK itself.
melee_damage_pct       % more melee damage
crit_chance            percentage points of crit chance
dodge_chance / parry_chance / riposte_chance / block_chance   percentage points (block needs a shield)
spell_potency_pct      % more spell damage and % more healing/heal-over-time from a heal spell
ability_damage_pct     % more damage from a PHYSICAL ability (backstab, bash, kicks, ...)
concentration          percentage points of chance to keep a spell when hit while casting
mana_regen             mana per 6-second regen tick
stamina_regen          sprint stamina regained per second
stamina_drain_pct      % less sprint stamina used (never below half)
bandage_heal_pct       % more healing from a bandage
double_attack_chance / triple_attack_chance   percentage points, for classes that can multi-attack (Aetherfist)
